statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog adds at least one CVE whose vendor or product field names Orkes Conductor, with a date-added value between 2026-09-19 and 2026-10-09.
resolution: The CISA KEV JSON feed contains an entry with vendorProject or product matching Orkes or Conductor and dateAdded between 2026-09-19 and 2026-10-09 inclusive.
failure_condition: No KEV entry naming Orkes Conductor carries a dateAdded value inside the 2026-09-19 to 2026-10-09 window.

statement: The CISA KEV catalog adds the SolarWinds ARM hard-coded key vulnerability disclosed 2026-09-19, with a date-added value between 2026-09-19 and 2026-10-16.
resolution: The CISA KEV JSON feed contains an entry with vendorProject SolarWinds and product Access Rights Manager or ARM whose dateAdded falls between 2026-09-19 and 2026-10-16 inclusive.
failure_condition: The KEV feed carries no SolarWinds Access Rights Manager entry with dateAdded inside the 2026-09-19 to 2026-10-16 window.

statement: WTI front-month crude settles below 90.00 dollars per barrel on at least one NYMEX trading day between 2026-09-21 and 2026-10-09. Reference: 96.08 on the packet date after a one-day fall of 5.24 percent.
resolution: The CME NYMEX official settlement for the front-month CL contract prints below 90.00 on any trading day between 2026-09-21 and 2026-10-09 inclusive; EIA daily spot series accepted as backup.
failure_condition: Every NYMEX front-month WTI settlement between 2026-09-21 and 2026-10-09 is at or above 90.00.

statement: The 10-year US Treasury constant-maturity yield closes at or above 5.25 percent on at least one business day between 2026-09-21 and 2026-10-30. Reference: 5.00 percent on the packet date.
resolution: FRED series DGS10 (Treasury H.15) records a value of 5.25 or higher for any date between 2026-09-21 and 2026-10-30 inclusive.
failure_condition: Every DGS10 observation dated 2026-09-21 through 2026-10-30 is below 5.25.

statement: The Federal Register publishes an executive order or OFAC notice terminating or removing Eritrea-related sanctions with a publication date between 2026-09-19 and 2026-10-16.
resolution: federalregister.gov shows a document whose title or abstract names Eritrea and terminates, revokes or removes sanctions authorities or designations, with publication_date between 2026-09-19 and 2026-10-16 inclusive.
failure_condition: No Federal Register document published 2026-09-19 through 2026-10-16 terminates or removes Eritrea-related sanctions.

statement: Saudi Arabia officially confirms the interception or impact of at least one further missile or drone directed at Riyadh Province between 2026-09-20 and 2026-09-30, following the first air-raid alerts for Riyadh reported 2026-09-19.
resolution: A Saudi Press Agency or Saudi Ministry of Defense statement dated 2026-09-20 to 2026-09-30 confirms an interception or impact in Riyadh Province, and at least two of Reuters, AP and AFP report it.
failure_condition: No Saudi official statement in the window confirms a missile or drone interception or impact in Riyadh Province, or no two wire services corroborate one.

statement: A US federal district court enters a temporary restraining order or preliminary injunction requiring the White House to restore press-pool or briefing access to reporters of CNN, Politico or MS NOW, with the order docketed between 2026-09-19 and 2026-10-16.
resolution: A PACER or CourtListener docket entry dated 2026-09-19 to 2026-10-16 records a TRO or preliminary injunction granting access relief to at least one of CNN, Politico or MS NOW against the Executive Office of the President or White House officials.
failure_condition: No federal docket shows a TRO or preliminary injunction restoring White House access to any of the three outlets entered inside the window.

statement: Nigeria at federal or Niger State level announces a formal judicial panel or commission of inquiry into the deaths of detainees at the Minna prison facility, with the announcement made between 2026-09-19 and 2026-10-09.
resolution: An official Nigerian federal or Niger State government statement dated 2026-09-19 to 2026-10-09 establishes a named panel or commission to investigate the Minna detainee deaths, reported by at least two of Reuters, AP, AFP, BBC and Premium Times.
failure_condition: No official Nigerian statement in the window establishes a panel or commission of inquiry into the Minna detainee deaths.

statement: Cuba suffers another full collapse of its national electrical grid between 2026-09-20 and 2026-10-20, publicly acknowledged by the Union Electrica or the Ministry of Energy and Mines.
resolution: Union Electrica or Cuba's Ministry of Energy and Mines acknowledges a total disconnection of the Sistema Electroenergetico Nacional occurring between 2026-09-20 and 2026-10-20 inclusive, corroborated by at least two of Reuters, AP, AFP and EFE.
failure_condition: No Cuban official acknowledgment of a total national grid disconnection dated inside the 2026-09-20 to 2026-10-20 window exists, or no two wire services corroborate one.

statement: USGS records an earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater within 300 km of the 2026-09-16 M6.5 event west of Nikolski, Alaska, occurring between 2026-09-20 and 2026-10-19.
resolution: The USGS earthquake catalog lists an event with magnitude at least 6.0 and epicenter within 300 km of USGS event us7000ti1p, origin time between 2026-09-20 and 2026-10-19 UTC inclusive.
failure_condition: The USGS catalog shows no M6.0 or greater event within 300 km of us7000ti1p with origin time inside the window.
